title: Courts and Public Offices, 2011–2016
grammar: Recap: degrees of certainty with valószínűleg, feltehetőleg and aligha
goal: I can describe the rules on judges and public offices between 2011 and 2016, with their dates (*nyugdíjkorhatár, Országos Bírósági Hivatal, Kúria*).
I can mark how certain a claim is with *valószínűleg*, *feltehetőleg* and *aligha* (*aligha vitatható*).
I can report what the European courts and the Venice Commission found, giving the year.
